tagline: Owner and operator of apartment communities focused on operational excellence and resident satisfaction
hero_kpi_rationale: Key measure of real estate operating performance, excludes financing and depreciation effects to assess the intrinsic profitability of the property portfolio

kpis.name: Net Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Net operating income from properties (total rental revenues minus operating expenses)
kpis.description: Net operating income from properties in 2025

kpis.name: Core Funds From Operations per Share
kpis.explanation: Core funds from operations per diluted share, a key non-GAAP metric for REITs
kpis.description: Core funds from operations per diluted share in 2025
kpis.signal: Increase in core funds from operations

kpis.name: Net Income per Diluted Share
kpis.explanation: Net income per diluted share under GAAP standards
kpis.description: Net income per diluted share in 2025

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last four years. Annually tracked indicator, historical values over the past four years.
kpis.signal: Total revenue of €0.27 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Operating income of €0.02 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €1.93 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €1.02 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €0.01 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Same-store NOI Growth YoY
kpis.explanation: Growth in net operating income for the stable portfolio of comparable properties
kpis.description: Year-over-year same-store net operating income growth in 2025
kpis.signal: Moderate growth in same-store net operating income
